request.prompt:
One real photograph of a classroom whiteboard calendar for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Photorealistic board, frame and marker ink; NOT an illustration, 3D render, screenshot or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no extra frames, padding, watermark or captions. The only writing is the calendar's own numbers: no letters, no words, no day names and no month names anywhere.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph after someone drew on the board with a pen. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 is a photograph of a whiteboard year planner with twelve numbered month boxes. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same framing, board, frame, header, lines, numbers and small grids. Do not move, redraw, add or remove any number. Add only this, drawn by hand with a dark-blue whiteboard pen, with slightly uneven ink: ONE loop around the single box number 5, enclosing that whole box with its number and its small grid: a freehand loop, slightly asymmetric, with a small overlapping end stroke, not a perfect geometric shape. The loop encloses exactly one month box and no other. No other mark.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
